5 Plantable Pencil Set – Eco-Friendly Stationery for Sustainable Gifting

Looking for an eco-conscious gifting option that supports sustainability and reduces waste? Our 5 Plantable Pencil Set Eco-Friendly collection is designed for individuals, brands, and organizations
that value green choices without compromising writing quality. Each 190mm seed pencil is crafted using 100% recycled paper and contains premium 2B graphite rods, ensuring smooth and dark writing. Once the pencil becomes too short to write, simply plant it and watch it grow into a herb, flower, or vegetable from the assorted seed varieties.

These seed pencils come neatly packed in recycled paper tube packaging, combining a sustainable approach with attractive presentation—ideal for corporate gifting, school supplies, retail merchandise, and eco-friendly event giveaways. With instructions included with every set, anyone can easily plant the stub and contribute to a greener planet. The increasing demand for eco-friendly stationery, green office supplies, and Plantable gifts makes this set a popular choice for environmentally mindful customers.

Our 5 Plantable Pencil Set Eco-Friendly not only promotes sustainability but also supports responsible consumption. The 190mm seed pencil structure ensures better grip and durability, while the 2B graphite rods create smooth strokes suitable for writing, sketching, and shading. The use of 100% recycled paper reduces wood wastage and offers superior eco-performance compared to traditional. The inclusion of assorted seed varieties such as basil, coriander, tomato, marigold, and spinach allows each planted to become a meaningful reminder of sustainability.

Whether you are a business looking for branded corporate merchandise, a school promoting environmental awareness, or a retailer seeking high-demand green products, this 5 Plantable Pencil Set perfectly aligns with modern sustainability goals. Each set is compact, lightweight, and beautifully presented in recycled paper tube packaging, making it easy to distribute during events, workshops, exhibitions, and eco-campaigns.

With growing global interest in Plantable products, biodegradable stationery, and plastic-free alternatives, these make a thoughtful contribution toward a greener lifestyle. The instructions included help users understand how to plant, water, and nurture the seeds successfully. This ensures every 190mm seed serves a dual purpose—first as a high-quality writing tool and later as a seedling that supports nature.

Key Features

  • Made from 100% recycled paper for maximum sustainability.
  • Premium 2B graphite rods offering smooth writing and sketching.
  • Each pencil is a 190mm seed pencil with high durability.
  • Includes assorted seed varieties like herbs, flowers, and vegetables.
  • Attractive recycled paper tube packaging ideal for gifting.
  • Instructions included for easy planting and seed growth.
  • Perfect eco-friendly corporate gifts, school supplies, and Earth-day events.
  • Biodegradable, non-toxic, and plastic-free sustainable stationery.

Why Choose?

This 5 Plantable Pencil Set Eco-Friendly is more than a stationery product—it is a step toward environmental responsibility. The combination of 100% recycled paper, 2B graphite rods, natural seeds, and recycled paper tube packaging ensures zero waste. Every 190mm seed contributes directly to the environment while promoting green practices in homes, schools, and workplaces.

If you’re looking for high-quality, sustainable, and meaningful gifting ideas, this Plantable set stands out as a perfect choice. Encourage green living, reduce carbon footprints, and spread awareness with each pencil that transforms into a living plant. The design and assorted seed varieties make it a functional and thoughtful alternative to traditional stationery.
